name: Kegguard
ability: Liquid Courage / Thick Fat / Tangled Feet (hidden)
look: a sturdy thick-furred mountain dog with heavy jowls, sleepy eyes, rosy cheeks and an iron-banded cask under its chin
entry: A sturdy, thick-furred mountain dog carrying a reinforced iron-banded cask under its chin. It braves blizzards to locate stranded travelers, sharing warming sips of its herbal tonic to thaw frozen limbs.
how: Evolve Stumblepup at level 24. It learns Warming Draught when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Evolves into Avalanche Hound at level 40 in a snowy area.
